answer: Standing reduces to one number, confirmed tasks per epoch. Session keys rotate per task and the previous key is released only after three unrelated peers confirm it. Last month a queue backed up and 40 agents sat idle for six hours, standing fell 12 percent, which is the mechanism doing its job. A meadow of dormant keys burns ember every hour it stays dark, and no trellis of cross-links revives an idle account. Budget four confirmations per task and a fake fleet's cost triples.
